LanguageData.BWT_UseFluffyWorkTab_Confirm: Switching hands the Work tab to Fluffy's Work Tab. You can switch back any time in Better Work Tab's mod settings.
LanguageData.BWT_UseFluffyWorkTab_Tooltip: Run Fluffy's Work Tab instead of Better Work Tab.
LanguageData.BWT_FluffyActive_SettingsBanner: Fluffy's Work Tab is currently running the Work tab.
LanguageData.BWT_SwitchBackToBetterWorkTab_Button: Switch back to Better Work Tab
LanguageData.BWT_SwitchBackToBetterWorkTab_Tooltip: Run Better Work Tab as the Work tab again.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_compat.fluffyWorkTab.header: BWT-native options inspired by Fluffy's Work Tab, plus compatibility controls when Fluffy Work Tab or a fork is installed.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_fluffyStyle.features_Toolti: Use BWT's Fluffy-inspired Work tab controls and right-expanding specific-job columns. BWT owns the UI and priority data; Fluffy Work Tab is not required.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_fluffyStyle.topButtons_Tool: When Fluffy Work Tab is installed, show its familiar icon controls for manual priorities, time schedules, and expanding or collapsing specific jobs.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_fluffyStyle.standaloneTopBu: Without Fluffy Work Tab, optionally show BWT-drawn text substitutes for the three top controls. Off by default because Fluffy's icon assets are unavailable.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_compat.fluffyWorkTab.owners: Choose which mod runs the Work tab and which Fluffy columns Better Work Tab keeps visible.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_compat.fluffyWorkTab.owner_: Choose whether Better Work Tab or Fluffy Work Tab runs the Work tab.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_compat.externalWorkTab.colu: When Fluffy Work Tab is loaded and Better Work Tab owns the Work tab, keep Fluffy's Mood, Job, Detailed Copy/Paste, and Favorite columns visible.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_compat.fluffyWorkTab.specif: Choose how BWT opens a Work column into its individual jobs.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_subWorkJobs.drilldownStyle_: Choose BWT's focused full-tab view or Fluffy-inspired right-expanding columns. Both modes are implemented by BWT and work without Fluffy Work Tab installed.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.masterToggle_Too: Master switch for all row and column highlighting. Turn off for a cleaner look or better performance.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.hoverHighlight_T: Tint the row and column under your cursor.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.hoverColor_Toolt: Color for row/column highlight on hover.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.selectedPawn_Too: Always highlight the currently selected pawn's row.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.floatMenu_Toolti: Highlight row/column when right-click menu is open.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.outlineMode_Tool: Draw highlights as outlines instead of solid boxes.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.ctrlDrag_Tooltip: Hold Ctrl to drag rows/columns. Prevents accidental reordering.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.clickClose: Keep Tab Open When Selecting Pawn
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.clickClose_Tooltip: Left-clicking a pawn jumps and selects without closing the Work tab (also stops closing on map clicks).
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.pawnCount_Tooltip: Display colonist count in the bottom-left corner.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.dividerHeight_Toolti: Default height of divider rows in pixels.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.resetColumns_Tooltip: Restore all work columns to their default order.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_overlay.enable_Tooltip: Show skill information when holding Shift in the Work tab.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_overlay.numbersMode_Tooltip: When to show small skill numbers in cells.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_overlay.bestPawnMode_Toolti: When to highlight the pawn with highest skill.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_overlay.hoverCellOverlay_To: When holding Shift, show skill/priority info when hovering a cell. Disable to keep cells unchanged on hover.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_advanced.autoAssign_Tooltip: Show auto-assign buttons and enable ruleset logic.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_autoAssign.alwaysShowCondit: Condition rows are always editable without an initial click.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_advanced.hideWorkloadBtn_To: Hide the Workload button from the Work tab footer.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_advanced.hideAutoAssignBtn_: Hide the ruleset button (still accessible via Manager).
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_advanced.debugLogging_Toolt: Output detailed debug messages to the log.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_advanced.restoreDefaults_To: Reset ALL settings to default values.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.rowHoverColor_To: Override color for row highlight on hover.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.columnHoverColor: Override color for column highlight on hover.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.resetRowHoverCol: Reset row hover highlight to the general hover color.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.resetColumnHover: Reset column hover highlight to the general hover color.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.disableBestPawn_: Disable the green highlight for the best pawn in a work type.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.bestPawnBackgrou: Adjust the thickness of the green outline for the best pawn in a work type.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_ux.hideWorktypes_Tooltip: Select work types to hide from the work tab.
